verdict.rationale: Meilisearch's API reference pages show static multi-language code samples, but a probe found the Mintlify playground set to "simple" display with the in-page runner disabled and no "Try it" control. The interactive, runnable part of the story is absent. The published OpenAPI spec and the Postman-import guide are a developer building block and external tooling, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
